_note: The freeze registry (task-packets/N1-T02.yaml R3). One entry per frozen version: the sha256 its bytes had when it was frozen. scripts/check_gold_freeze.py fails when a registered version's file no longer hashes to its pinned value, and CI runs it on every push. A gold set is never edited — a changed standard is a NEW set_id with a NEW entry, and the old entry stays so every past measurement remains interpretable. Adding an entry is how a set becomes frozen; removing or rewriting one is how a measurement quietly starts meaning something else, which is what this file exists to prevent.

mb-cls-criteria-v1.note: The criteria the 60 cases were drawn under. SUPERSEDED by v2 after Ulysses' objection, and deliberately still frozen: an objection is only legible if the thing objected to is still readable.

mb-cls-criteria-v2.note: The criteria in force. Locked before any label is made; the order gate refuses a set labelled earlier. SUPERSEDED by v3: its locked_at was two hours in the future of the act it licensed. Kept frozen — the error is only legible while the erroneous object is readable.

mb-cls-criteria-v3.note: The criteria in force. v3 corrects a lock instant that was a wall-clock reading stamped as UTC — the defect the labelling practice found by refusing to move its own timestamp to pass the gate. Definitions byte-identical to v2 so the completed blind labelling stays valid.

mb-cls-ulysses-v1-restamped._note: The real standard, registered by N1-T04. It was measured against on 2026-08-01 while absent from this registry: the other six entries are the three criteria versions and the three SYNTHETIC fixtures, so the CI check built to catch a moved standard did not cover the standard. The labels were guarded transitively by two unit tests; that is a good chain and it is not this mechanism. Registered by the first packet to produce a real measurement against it, because a measurement resting on a file CI does not hold still is a measurement that can change meaning without anyone touching it.

mb-cls-v1-synthetic.note: NOT a standard. The synthetic fixture that exercises the apparatus; its class distribution reproduces N1-T02 AT1's hand-computed oracle, so its bytes moving would silently invalidate that oracle. Registered for exactly that reason. Its label_provenance.producing_practice is 'synthetic-fixture', which the loader refuses for real evaluation unless --allow-synthetic is passed. SUPERSEDED by mb-cls-v2-synthetic, which the loader can read under criteria v2; this one predates decided_by and stays frozen as history.

mb-cls-v2-synthetic.note: NOT a standard. The criteria-v2 synthetic fixture: mb-cls-v1-synthetic's twenty cases carried over unchanged (so N1-T02 AT1's oracle still holds) plus decided_by, three tie_with, and three undecidable cases. Registered because its bytes moving would silently invalidate that oracle.

mb-cls-v3-synthetic.note: The synthetic fixture re-issued against criteria v3. Labels and predictions unchanged from v2, so N1-T02 AT1's oracle still holds.
